create_scheduler_metrics_collector: create a SchedulerMetricsCollector to log Prometheus gauges, histograms, and counters for scheduler state
log_scheduler_stats: log scheduler statistics including running requests, token usage, and KV cache metrics via SchedulerMetricsCollector.log_stats
observe_request_latency: observe per-stage request latency, time to first token, and inter-token latency histograms via TokenizerMetricsCollector
track_kv_cache_eviction: track KV cache eviction and load-back durations and token counts via RadixCacheMetricsCollector
get_histogram_config_from_env: get histogram bucket configuration as float list from an environment variable string
